# Seeker Estates

> Seeker Estates is a London serviced accommodation company. Guests book whole serviced apartments and homes directly,
> for short stays or monthly (mid-term) stays. London landlords hand over their property for full management or guaranteed rent.

Key facts (page updated 06 November 2026):
- 19 homes: 18 across London and 1 in Kings Langley, near Warner Bros. Studio Tour London.
- 520+ guest reviews, 8.9 on Booking.com, 90% average occupancy.
- Booking direct on https://seekerestates.com/book/ is 10% below Airbnb and Booking.com for the same home.
- Landlord fees: fully managed 15% + VAT, mid-term 12% + VAT, guaranteed rent quoted per property, £0 set-up.
- Contact: corentin@seekerestates.com · WhatsApp +44 7397 573367 · Seeker Estates Ltd · Company no. 15310020 · Registered in England & Wales

## Guests
- [Book direct](https://seekerestates.com/book/): live availability and secure booking.

## Areas
- [Canary Wharf (E14)](https://seekerestates.com/areas/canary-wharf/): River views, the Elizabeth line on the doorstep and the quickest hop to ExCeL and The O2. Ideal for business trips, exhibitions and concerts.
- [Marylebone (W1)](https://seekerestates.com/areas/marylebone/): A village in the middle of the West End: Marylebone High Street, Regent's Park and Oxford Street within a walk.
- [St John's Wood (NW8)](https://seekerestates.com/areas/st-johns-wood/): Leafy, quiet and very London: Abbey Road, Lord's Cricket Ground, Regent's Park and the canals of Little Venice.
- [Camden & Primrose Hill (NW1)](https://seekerestates.com/areas/camden-primrose-hill/): Markets, live music and the best free view of London from the top of Primrose Hill.
- [Islington (N1)](https://seekerestates.com/areas/islington/): Upper Street's restaurants and theatres, and a straight run into the City and King's Cross.
- [Greenwich & Woolwich (SE10)](https://seekerestates.com/areas/greenwich/): Maritime Greenwich, the Cutty Sark and the river — with The O2 and the Elizabeth line close at hand.
- [Notting Hill & Bayswater (W2)](https://seekerestates.com/areas/notting-hill-bayswater/): Portobello Road, Hyde Park and Paddington's direct trains to Heathrow.
- [West London (W12)](https://seekerestates.com/areas/west-london/): Westfield, Stamford Bridge, Wembley within easy reach and a direct line to Heathrow.
- [Near the Studio Tour (WD4)](https://seekerestates.com/areas/harry-potter-studio-tour/): A modern two-bedroom base around 10 minutes from the Warner Bros. Studio Tour London, with parking.
